messages:
arthur (Product): Quick sync on the in-product help panel — noticed a few UX and copy frictions during the customer demo. putting them here so we can triage. jared (Design): cool, what did you see? arthur (Product): 3 main things: 1) placeholder text mismatch: help panel search says "Search help" but docs site uses "Search the docs". 2) deep links from the panel land on the docs landing page, not the specific section; that forces users to re-search. 3) glossary terms: Console shows "endpoint" in a few places but docs use "route" — confuses engineers. nina (Docs): thanks — we intentionally used "route" to match API reference. happy to add a note and an alias list if frontend will keep "endpoint" for now. hui (Frontend): alias list sounds good. implementation note: our help panel link generator currently strips query params for cleanliness. we can preserve them so deep anchors work (e.g. /docs/guides/model-ops#caching?src=console). amanda (Eng): infra concern: if we add src=console to docs links, we'd like to whitelist and strip any sensitive params server-side. shouldn't be a problem but want to flag. a11y-bot: a11y check: ensure help panel toggle has aria-expanded and the search input has aria-label="Search docs" for SR clarity. Also ensure color contrast on the placeholder meets AA. jared (Design): proposal: unify to "Search the docs" in the panel, change in-product copy from "endpoint" -> "route" where it refers to API routes, and add a small inline glossary link in the panel: "See glossary (routes vs endpoints)". mock: ```html
  • Caching guide (opens in new tab)
    • ``` nina (Docs): i'll add an alias line on the glossary page: "route (sometimes called endpoint in the Console)" and add an anchor id for caching guide. i'll open PR. hui (Frontend): will update the markdown template to preserve ?src=console and add analytics event: `trackEvent('help_panel.link_click', { href, src: 'console' })`. also will change the placeholder copy. drafting PR. amanda (Eng): infra-bot: please add docs.redwood-inference.com to CSP allowlist for the console iframe. infra-bot? infra-bot: CSP update ticket created: https://infra.redwood/changes/5678 — ETA 2 days. a11y-bot: quick regression checklist: focus inside panel on open, trap focus, escape closes, input labelled, link list has role=list and listitems. i'll add to QA checklist. arthur (Product): next steps: nina PR for alias & anchor, hui PR for placeholder + link template + analytics, infra to update CSP, a11y tests from QA. can folks paste PR links here when ready and i'll mark the Linear card: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/CON-4892-help-panel-glossary-sync nina (Docs): docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2412 — adds alias + anchor. hui (Frontend): console draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/811 — preserves query params + copy change. still adding analytics. amanda (Eng): CSP ticket referenced above. will follow up once it's live. arthur (Product): thanks all. once PRs merge let's run a short sanity check with a couple of PMs before rolling out. :thumbsup:
